page_title: ACM 2-3 ATA | AC Milan v Atalanta 10/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Surely that's handball by one of the Atalanta players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

90+7' What an opportunity! Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
90+6' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is booked.
90+5' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+4' 2 - 3 Goal! Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Carnesecchi into the roof of the net.
90+4' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
90+2' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) tackles a bit over-zealously and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for AC Milan!
90+2' Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The referee has issued a yellow card to Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan).
89' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) is given a yellow card.

88' 1 - 3 Goal! Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Samuele Ricci, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot low inside the right post. What a finish that is - 1:3!
88' Luca Zufferli interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta). AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from AC Milan comes to nothing.

87' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
84' The AC Milan players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
81' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
80' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Davide Bartesaghi is replaced by Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan).
80' What an opportunity! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
78' AC Milan have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman makes the right call and AC Milan will have a corner.
76' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the crossbar.
74' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle after Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
71' Isak Hien (Atalanta) will miss the next game.
70' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
69' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
68' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) heads on.
68' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
64' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
63' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere is replaced by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
63' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) replaces Odilon Kossounou.
61' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
58' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Koni De Winter will be replaced by Zachary Athekame (AC Milan).
58' Today's match ends for Santiago Tomas Gimenez who will be replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rafael Leao trots off the pitch and is replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
56' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
55' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) replacing Davide Zappacosta.
55' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.
51' 0 - 3 Goal! Giacomo Raspadori (Atalanta) is teed up on the edge of the box by Ederson, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 0:3.
48' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Giorgio Scalvini leaves the pitch to be replaced by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta).
47' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
46' Substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek will be replaced by Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Luca Zufferli has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
41' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
39' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
38' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) is flagged for offside.
36' A pass into the box finds Rafael Leao (AC Milan) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marco Carnesecchi denies him.
34' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is lucky to receive a yellow card from the referee because he could easily have been given a red card for his foul.
29' 0 - 2 Goal! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Nikola Krstovic, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
27' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) makes a slide tackle, but referee Luca Zufferli blows for a foul.
25' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.

23' AC Milan are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
20' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).
17' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

17' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan is equal to the effort and makes a good save. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
15' Excellent touch by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
11' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul.

7' 0 - 1 Goal! Ederson (Atalanta) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Mike Maignan is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:1.
5' A clumsy foul by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle.
4' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
1' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi is equal to it and makes an easy save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
AC Milan will kick the game off.
Luca Zufferli got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
